title: Marquee Health joins the Alight Partner Network, bringing biometric screenings and health coaching into the benefits experience
body_markdown:
Alight, Inc. (NYSE: ALIT), a leading benefits administration provider of health, wealth and leave solutions, today announced that[Marquee Health](https://www.alight.com/partners/partner-network/meet-our-partners#marquee_health) , a CuraLinc company, has joined the Alight Partner Network, bringing biometric screenings, personalized health coaching and wellbeing engagement resources to employees’ benefits experience.


[Marquee Health](https://marqueehealth.com/) helps employers drive engagement and support lasting lifestyle change through an outcomes-driven suite of health and wellness programs.[As a member of the Alight Partner Network](https://www.alight.com/partners/partner-network/meet-our-partners?utm_campaign=dec_marquee_health_2026_09_us) , Marquee Health is now easier for employees and their families to access through a more connected benefits journey. Personalized coaching, biometric screenings and tailored content help participants identify, build and sustain healthy habits over time.


“Employers are looking for simpler ways to connect employees with health and wellbeing resources that feel relevant, easy to use and measurable,” said Jessica Borchik, SVP, Partner Strategy and Sales at Alight. “We welcome the addition of Marquee Health to the Alight Partner Network, as Marquee reflects our focus on reducing complexity for HR teams while helping employees better understand their health and take meaningful action.”


Alight’s 2026 Employee Mindset Study found that 43% of employees admit delaying or avoiding medical care because it felt too difficult or confusing. By bringing Marquee Health’s biometric screenings, personalized health coaching and wellbeing engagement resources into the Alight benefits experience, employers can make it easier for employees to understand their health, access support, take action and stay engaged over time.


“At Marquee Health, we believe wellbeing programs should be easy to access, simple to manage and meaningful for employees at every stage of their health journey,” said Jonathon Short, President, Marquee Health. “Joining the Alight Partner Network enables us to meet employees within their existing benefits experience, helping employers drive participation while giving employees the support and insights they need to make informed health decisions.”


[Learn more about Alight’s Partner Network](https://www.alight.com/partners/partner-network/meet-our-partners?utm_campaign=dec_marquee_health_2026_09_us) .
